chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to me. He said: Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Shu'ayb al-Sayrafi from al-Haytham Abu Kahmas from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Six qualities will benefit a believer after his death: a righteous child who seeks forgiveness on his behalf, a mus'haf that is recited from, a well that he dug, a plant that he planted, running water that he gave in charity, and a beautiful tradition that is practiced after him.

key_terms.سنة حسنة: A beautiful tradition -- a good practice established for others to follow
key_terms.قليب: A well -- specifically a deep well dug for water
key_terms.مصحف: Mus'haf -- a written copy of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What six things benefit a believer after death according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) enumerates six lasting deeds whose reward continues to reach a believer beyond the grave: (1) a righteous child praying for him, (2) a Quran copy from which people recite, (3) a well he dug, (4) trees he planted, (5) water he channeled as charity, and (6) a good practice that others follow after him. This hadith emphasizes sadaqa jariya (continuous charity) and the enduring nature of beneficial deeds.
